properties.name: Session posture
properties.purpose:
What a session knows about WHERE IT IS and WHETHER IT IS CURRENT: the latent server in a directory that has not opted in, the staleness of the shared record since this seat last looked, and saying what design lives at a path without binding to it.

Grouped because all three answer a question asked BEFORE any design work — am I somewhere with a design, is what I hold current, and what is here. Each is also a place where an honest "I cannot tell" matters more than an answer, which is why they sit together under an observability target.
